title: Ball bearings fatigue — Weibull
note: Millions of revolutions to fatigue failure of 23 deep-groove ball bearings (Lieblein and Zelen 1956), all failed. Weakly informative lognormal priors: shape with median 1.65, scale with median 100 Mrev. The maximum likelihood fit is shape 2.10 and scale 81.9 Mrev; the posterior should sit close to it. Shape above 1 means wear-out.
note_pt: Milhões de revoluções até a falha por fadiga de 23 rolamentos de esferas (Lieblein e Zelen 1956), todos falhados. Prioris lognormais pouco informativas: forma com mediana 1,65 e escala com mediana 100 Mrev. O ajuste de máxima verossimilhança é forma 2,10 e escala 81,9 Mrev; a posteriori deve ficar perto disso. Forma acima de 1 indica desgaste.
source: Lieblein, J. and Zelen, M. (1956). Statistical investigation of the fatigue life of deep-groove ball bearings. Journal of Research of the National Bureau of Standards 57(5), 273-316. Also in Lawless (2003), Statistical Models and Methods for Lifetime Data, 2nd ed., Wiley.
source_pt: Lieblein, J. e Zelen, M. (1956). Statistical investigation of the fatigue life of deep-groove ball bearings. Journal of Research of the National Bureau of Standards 57(5), 273-316. Também em Lawless (2003), Statistical Models and Methods for Lifetime Data, 2ª ed., Wiley.
